solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Chicken's bed about to be pinched by slug

indicators.note: something pinched by another is squeezed between its sides, so the bed and 'about' sit inside the slug

parts.note: to slug someone is to sock or punch them
a bed of flowers or vegetables is a patch
C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A chicken's resting place is about to be squashed by a garden slug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chicken's' is 'Chicken is'. A spatchcock is a chicken split open and flattened for grilling.
explanation.definitionFit: A culinary term for a bird, usually a chicken, split down the back and opened flat to cook.

clue.text: People regularly wasted time in appeal

indicators.note: the time abbreviation is placed in the distress call

parts.note: SOS is the international appeal for help

explanation.surface: Some people keep frittering away their hours begging for help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' looks like an alternate-letter signal, but it belongs to the definition: people who are habitually drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Drunkards are people who are habitually intoxicated, and 'wasted' is slang for very drunk.

clue.text: Clue provider's strain to stop in retirement

parts.note: a strain of music, a melody, is an aria

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the word for stop is read backwards

parts.note: to stop is to end

explanation.surface: A setter's tune stops when they retire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clue provider's' is 'Clue provider has'. In Greek myth Ariadne gave Theseus a ball of thread, or clew, to find his way out of the Labyrinth.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth, the princess gave Theseus the thread (an old sense of clue) that guided him out of the Minotaur's maze.

clue.text: Stress from engagement card and a gift being misplaced interrupting a day

parts.note: to card wool is to comb it

indicators.note: the shuffled letters break into the middle of the day abbreviation

parts.note: TUE is short for Tuesday, a day

indicators.note: the letters of 'a gift' are put out of place, rearranged

explanation.surface: An engagement card and a mislaid present cause stress on the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being misplaced' rearranges the first 'a gift'; the A of 'a day' is used as it stands. 'Engagement' means battle, not betrothal.
explanation.definitionFit: The term for psychological breakdown suffered by soldiers after prolonged battle, an engagement being a military clash.

clue.text: Work on PC's daughter replacing spy chief in future

indicators.note: the daughter abbreviation takes the place of the spy chief's letter

parts.note: coming, as in the coming years, means future
M is the head of MI6 in the James Bond stories

explanation.surface: A policeman's daughter will take over from the spymaster one day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'PC's' reads as a police constable's but is 'PC is'; PC is the computer.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing program instructions for a computer is the activity of programming, or working on a PC.

clue.text: Arm's put out, the forepart

parts.note: someone put out is annoyed, or cross
the bow is the front part of a ship

explanation.surface: An arm has been dislocated at its front end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arm's' is 'Arm is'; arm here means a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval weapon firing bolts, and an arm is any weapon.

clue.text: Cosmetic coat unevenly spread with edges of trowel

indicators.note: the chosen letters are spread about, rearranged
the uneven, odd-numbered letters of the word coat are taken
only the first and last letters of trowel are used

explanation.surface: A cosmetic layer applied patchily, smoothed out with a trowel's edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unevenly' takes C and A from 'coat'; 'edges of' takes T and L from 'trowel'; 'spread' rearranges CATL.
explanation.definitionFit: Talcum powder is a toiletry dusted on the skin, so it counts as a cosmetic.

clue.text: Creative person's space invention runs, having worried superior

indicators.note: in a down answer, superior means placed above, so the word for worried goes on top

parts.note: worried at something means ate away at it
an invention is a lie or fabrication
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Something about an inventor's room and a boss who is anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's or designer's studio is the workroom where creative people work.

clue.text: New dawn sweeps past

parts.note: to sweep is to clean, so sweeps gives cleans
late, as in the late king, means past or former

explanation.surface: A fresh morning brushes away what has gone before.
explanation.definitionFit: A fresh start with the past wiped away is figuratively a new beginning or dawn.

clue.text: Heard about Napoleon's men getting decorated

indicators.note: the word for heard goes round the Frenchmen's abbreviation

parts.note: a case heard in court is tried
MM is short for Messieurs, French gentlemen

explanation.surface: Napoleon's soldiers were rumoured to have been given medals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heard' looks like a sound signal, but it is the court sense. 'Napoleon's men' are any Frenchmen, abbreviated MM.
explanation.definitionFit: Trimmed clothes or hats are adorned with ribbons or lace, so decorated.

clue.text: Nasty fuss following task ignored by leader

indicators.note: the fuss comes after the shortened task
the word for task loses its leading letter

parts.note: a job is a task
to make a scene is to make a fuss

explanation.surface: An unpleasant row breaks out after the boss neglects a chore.
explanation.definitionFit: Something offensive and disgusting, as obscene can mean grossly nasty.

clue.text: Dazzling sign rehashed with lilac tint

indicators.note: rehashed means reworked, so the letters of sign and lilac tint are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sign repainted in a pale purple shade looks dazzling.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparkling or brilliantly lively, a figurative sense of giving off sparks.

clue.text: In row, sceptic repulsed excellent health care worker

indicators.note: the sceptic and the turned-round excellent go in the word for row

parts.note: a din is a noisy row
an agnostic is sceptical about God

indicators.note: repulsed means driven back, so the letters for excellent are reversed

parts.note: A1 is excellent, written AI in crosswords

explanation.surface: A doubting medic is pushed back in a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repulsed' reverses AI to IA. 'row' is a noisy quarrel, not a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical expert whose job is identifying illnesses works in health care.

clue.text: European sports car covered by nettle plant, partly

indicators.note: the European and the car are wrapped inside the word for nettle

parts.note: a stinging nettle is informally a stinger
MG is a British make of sports car

explanation.surface: A European sports car is overgrown with nettles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly' belongs to the definition: the answer is part of a plant, the stem or rhizome of ginger.
explanation.definitionFit: Preserved young ginger rhizome is one part of the ginger plant.

clue.text: Start letter poorly

parts.note: tee is the spelt-out name of the letter T
feeling off means feeling poorly

explanation.surface: A letter begins badly.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf, driving the first shot of a hole is how play starts, hence to begin.

clue.text: Pescatarian tucked into portion not containing a bird

indicators.note: the fish-eater is slipped inside the shortened portion
the portion word has its A removed

parts.note: a deal is a portion or share, as in a great deal
an otter eats fish, a humorous pescatarian

explanation.surface: A fish-eater tucked into a helping that had no poultry in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not containing a' removes A from DEAL to leave DEL. 'Tucked into' plays on eating.
explanation.definitionFit: A small plover of moorland and coasts is a kind of wading bird.

clue.text: Broadcast about rising pollution is commanding attention

indicators.note: the word for broadcast goes around the turned-up pollution

parts.note: a broadcast message is sent out

indicators.note: in a down answer, rising means read upwards, so the word for pollution is reversed

parts.note: dirt is pollution

explanation.surface: A broadcast about rising pollution grabs attention.
explanation.definitionFit: A harsh, loud voice or a forceful campaign demands to be noticed.

clue.text: Wrongly specify pine for gallery

parts.note: to pine for someone is to miss them
the Tate is a London art gallery

explanation.surface: Mistakenly naming pine wood as the material for a gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: To report or state something incorrectly is to give a wrong specification.

clue.text: Support American involved in slur

indicators.note: the American abbreviation is placed inside the word for slur

parts.note: a slur on someone's reputation is a stain

explanation.surface: Backing an American caught up in a smear campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear up or keep something going is to support it.

clue.text: Elastic factory one's invested in

indicators.note: the one is put into the factory as capital is invested in a business

parts.note: a plant is a factory
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A rubber factory that one person has put money into.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flexible or easily bent is supple, which is what elastic describes.

clue.text: Caper around old hills, originally ancient city

indicators.note: the word for caper goes around the old abbreviation

parts.note: an antic is a playful caper

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of hills is taken

explanation.surface: Larking about over the old hills was originally how an ancient city began.
explanation.definitionFit: Antioch was a major Hellenistic city founded around 300 BC, in modern Turkey.

clue.text: Fervour to hold in stomach reduced physique

indicators.note: the word for fervour holds the shortened stomach inside it

parts.note: fire is passion or fervour

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the stomach word loses its last letter

parts.note: a gut is the stomach

explanation.surface: Passion to keep the belly trim gives a better build.
explanation.definitionFit: One's figure is the shape of one's body, so physique.

clue.text: Minor is financing IT complex

indicators.note: complex means intricately put together, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A trivial matter is financing a complicated computer system.
explanation.definitionFit: Something trivial or of little importance is minor.

clue.text: Foreboding wife shunned by females

indicators.note: the wife abbreviation is avoided, dropped from the word for females

parts.note: women are females

explanation.surface: A wife fears being cold-shouldered by the other women.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent of what is to come, especially something bad, is a sign of foreboding.

clue.text: Lecherous look clearing centre of Bayeux

parts.note: a glade is a clearing in a wood

indicators.note: the two middle letters of Bayeux are taken

explanation.surface: A leering glance at the middle of the Bayeux Tapestry.
explanation.definitionFit: An amorous or leering glance is an idiom for a lustful look.

clue.text: Regular guy's heart, all can understand

definitions.meaning: regular means even and unvarying, the same throughout
the middle letter of guy, U, spoken in the radio alphabet that everyone can understand

explanation.surface: An ordinary fellow's feelings are plain to everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: The NATO phonetic alphabet, designed so letters are understood by all over the radio, gives this word for U, the heart of 'guy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Constant and unchanging in form is the adjective sense, matching regular.

clue.text: US city rejecting any of educational basics

indicators.note: rejecting means turning back, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: the educational basics are the three Rs, so any one of them is one R

explanation.surface: An American city turns down any of the three Rs of schooling.
explanation.walkthrough: The three Rs are reading, writing and arithmetic, the basics of schooling.
explanation.definitionFit: A city in Nevada, known for gambling and quick divorces, is in the USA.

clue.text: Temper half lost about ultimately galling article in news

indicators.note: half of lost means its second half

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: the last letter of galling and the article go between the two Ns

parts.note: N is short for new, so news can be two Ns

indicators.note: ultimately means the last letter of galling

parts.note: the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Lost half one's temper over something galling in the news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' takes ST from 'lost'. 'Temper' looks like anger, but it is the verb meaning toughen, as tempering steel.
explanation.definitionFit: To temper metal or glass is to harden and toughen it.
